examples.pie: ḱóymōs ḱléwsete. kéh₃tus wiHróns gʷr̥h₃ét. dʰéǵʰōm gʷʰn̥tóns ḱéletu kʷyéh₁tis-kʷe wos ḱléytreh₂ h₁éstu. kéh₃tus légʰtu. h₂érh₃trom tl̥nh₂té h₂éǵrom-kʷe h₂érh₃yete. ḱóymoh₁ gʷíh₃woyh₁tām.

examples.en: The praiser recited, and we listened.

examples.pie: h₁yód sh₂itós bʰéwgeti h₁ím-kʷe kʷis lémbʰeti h₁ím h₂ew wédʰetu. h₁yós sh₂itóm spéreti só dwóh₁ sh₂itóh₁ déh₃tu h₁óytom-kʷe h₁épetor. sh₂itósyo wósn̥ déḱm̥ gʷówes.
examples.en: If a bound one flees and a man seizes him, let him lead him back. Whoever frees a bound one, let him give two bound ones and he shall take the oath. The price of a bound one is ten cattle.

examples.pie: ǵʰwḗr h₂éwibʰos h₂epó ih₂dʰí. h₁íh₂n̥s mē h₁éps moysóm mē lémbʰs. ḱóymom gʰórtom mē gʷéms gʷowsth₂óm-wē mē gʷéms. dedórḱh₂e-ge te nu me ne dedórḱth₂e. sh₂itós h₁sdʰí nu sélos ih₂dʰí. h₁éy-kʷe h₁régʷos h₂epó bʰugyéh₁t.
examples.en: Wild beast, go away from the sheep! Do not seize them, do not seize the ram. Do not come to the homely enclosure or to the cow-stall. I have seen you indeed; now you do not see me. Be bound! Now go to the marsh. And may he flee away into the darkness!

examples.pie: swópniyom nékʷti widóm. kʷíd widés? wĺ̥kʷos me sékʷeto. bʰéyh₂m̥. mē bʰéyh₂s. swópniyom ne wĺ̥kʷos. swópniyosyo kʷim wĺ̥kʷos ne h₁ḗdti.
examples.en: I saw a dream in the night. What did you see? A wolf was following me. I became afraid. Do not be afraid! A dream is not a wolf. The wolf of a dream eats no one.

examples.pie: swópniyeh₂ widéh₁yesi? h₁íh₂ widéh₁yoh₂. ph₂térm̥ moy swópniyoy dʰǵʰyés widóm. h₁éy péruti mért. smḗyt gʷéHyet-kʷe moy. h₁éy te lubʰyéti.
examples.en: Do you see dreams? I see them. Yesterday I saw my father in a dream. He died last year. He was laughing and singing to me. He loves you.

examples.pie: h₁súmenes swópniyom nékʷti widóm. kʷíd widés? albʰós h₁éḱwos dʰwóri sth₂éh₁yet bʰéh₂t-kʷe moy. kʷíd wéwket? ḱód wéwket. yóh₁r̥ h₁wésu h₁éseti. deywṓs nos h₁wésu yóh₁r̥ dh₃ih₁ént. nu sth₂dʰí. stéh₂dʰh₁om méneti.
examples.en: Kindly One, I saw a dream in the night. What did you see? A white horse was standing at the door, and it spoke to me. What did it say? It said this: The year will be good. May the gods give us a good year! Now get up. The herd is waiting.

examples.pie: h₂ridʰmokʷértrom kʷértrom? h₁íd kʷértrom. h₁eǵóh₂ werdʰokʷr̥tḗr h₂ridʰmokʷértroy-kʷe tḱéymi. h₁íd toy dṓm? dṓm méǵʰye ne h₁ésti.
examples.en: Is a computer a machine? It is a machine. I am a word-maker, and I dwell in a computer. Is it a house for you? I have no house.

source.name: coinage
source.note: Determinative 'number-machine' (h₂ridʰmós 'number, count', Gk ἀριθμός, OIr. rím + kʷértrom 'machine'); calque of 'computer' / Fr. ordinateur in the counting sense (Gmc. Rechner 'reckoner').

source.name: coinage
source.note: Agent noun in -tōr 'weaver' from tek- 'weave' (LIV² 2.*tek- 'weben, flechten'; téksti 'weaves'), with the e-grade, root-accented shape of the inherited -tōr nouns (wékʷtōr): the model is Lat. textor 'weaver' to texō (built on the s-present), with Gk ὑφάντης 'weaver' to ὑφαίνω.
